0.1.name: text_to_sql
0.1.description: Text-to-SQL domain prior over the business/data domain of the question (mirrors dataset domain + domain_description).

0.5.name: sql_complexity_class
0.5.description: SQL complexity class of the target query (mirrors sql_complexity + sql_complexity_description): e.g. single join, aggregation, subquery, window function.

2.0.name: query_relation
2.0.description: Core relational structure of the query: the join/aggregation relation linking the question intent to the SQL.

4.0.name: query_feature_attribute
4.0.description: Discriminative query features: filters, grouping, ordering, and predicates that distinguish near-identical SQL.

6.0.name: db_schema_context
6.0.description: Database schema context needed to interpret the query (mirrors sql_context: CREATE TABLE + INSERT statements).

10.0.name: nl_question
10.0.description: Natural-language question to be answered by SQL (mirrors sql_prompt); the main content axis.

12.0.name: sql_query
12.0.description: The SQL query that answers the question (mirrors sql); the retrieval target/evidence.

18.0.name: source_table
18.0.description: Source/driving table of the query's joins (parsed from the SQL FROM clause).

19.0.name: joined_table
19.0.description: Joined/target table(s) of the query (parsed from the SQL JOIN clauses).

24.0.name: sql_function
24.0.description: Named SQL functions/operations used (COUNT, SUM, AVG, MIN, MAX, GROUP BY, window functions).

30.0.name: table_column_identifiers
30.0.description: Table and column identifiers referenced by the query (parsed from the SQL); the discriminative signal that separates near-identical SQL differing only by names.

40.0.name: sql_clause_detail
40.0.description: Statement-level SQL clause detail: predicates, literals, aliases, and ordering specifics (parsed from the SQL).

50.0.name: query_rationale
50.0.description: Explanation mapping the question to the SQL construction (mirrors sql_explanation).

70.0.name: sql_task_type
70.0.description: SQL task type label (mirrors sql_task_type + sql_task_type_description): e.g. analytics, reporting, data retrieval, data manipulation.
